name: Rehoboam
summary: The son of Solomon who became king after him. When he answered the people harshly, the tribes of Israel broke away, and he was left to reign over Judah from Jerusalem.

key_moments.title: Harsh Words at Shechem
key_moments.description: At Shechem the people asked Rehoboam to lighten the heavy yoke his father had put on them. He turned from the counsel of the old men, followed the young men, and promised them a heavier yoke.

key_moments.title: The Kingdom Splits
key_moments.description: Israel rejected the house of David and stoned Adoram, the officer over the tribute. Rehoboam fled to Jerusalem in his chariot, and only Judah followed the house of David.

key_moments.title: Told Not to Fight
key_moments.description: Rehoboam gathered an army to win back the kingdom, but the LORD sent word by Shemaiah not to fight against their brothers. The people listened and went home.

key_moments.title: Shields of Brass
key_moments.description: Shishak king of Egypt came against Jerusalem and took away the treasures, including the shields of gold Solomon had made. Rehoboam made shields of brass in their place.
